html:
Here is NGC3628 on the evening of March 15, 2010.

NGC 3628 is a spiral galaxy, located about 35 million light-years away, in the constellation Leo and is a member of the Leo Triplet

The image is uncropped at 25% of the original size.


Technical details
Optical train = lx200 10" f6.3 - MPCC - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon 40 unfiltered
Temperature between 7 deg and 4 deg
Site: At home
Focus with Bahtinov mask
40 exposures of 5min for 200 minutes
40 dark 40 flat 40 bias
DeepSkyStacker + PhotoShop + carboni + neatImage + gradiant Xterminator
Guided with QHY5 on the sky90
